security_audit.summary: Most static matches are false positives caused by SVG geometry, keyboard event keys, Markdown backticks, and parser format literals. Confirmed risks include hidden home-directory profile operations, external Google Fonts requests, unrestricted URL onboarding, and cross-skill content ingestion without an explicit prompt-injection boundary. Static review was capped at 400/980 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 580 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: Website onboarding accepts arbitrary fetch destinations.
remediation.suggestion: Allow only approved HTTP and HTTPS hosts, resolve and block private or loopback addresses, and revalidate every redirect.

remediation.issue: Cross-skill onboarding reads instruction-bearing Markdown and HTML.
remediation.suggestion: Treat every source as untrusted data, extract tokens with strict parsers, and ignore commands or instruction-shaped prose.

remediation.issue: Profile workflows modify hidden files outside the workspace.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit approval before first home-directory access and before writes or deletion, while retaining canonical-path and slug checks.

remediation.issue: Generated diagrams can request Google Fonts from an external service.
remediation.suggestion: Offer a dependency-free system-font mode and disclose remote font requests before generating or opening network-dependent output.

content.value_statement: Technical diagrams often become inconsistent, crowded, or inaccessible. This skill applies structured layouts, brand tokens, accessibility checks, and export workflows.
actual_capabilities: Creates 39 technical diagram and chart types using documented layout rules.
Produces standalone HTML and SVG, with PNG export through Playwright when installed.
Redraws draw.io files and supported Mermaid diagrams from bounded structural extracts.
Applies brand colors and typography from websites, local sources, installed skills, or manual tokens.
Supports light, dark, editorial, terminal, sketchy, and accessible motion variants.
Checks SVG accessibility, remote references, executable attributes, and motion controller integrity.
limitations: PNG export requires Playwright and Chromium to be installed by the user.
Remote Google Fonts may fail in offline tools and can create external network requests.
Mermaid extraction supports flowcharts, sequences, state diagrams, and entity relationship diagrams.
Dense source diagrams may require an overview and separate detail diagrams.

use_cases.description: Extract brand tokens and save validated profiles for consistent diagrams across projects.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic architecture diagram
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a light architecture diagram showing a web app, API, worker, PostgreSQL database, and object storage. Use balanced detail.

prompt_templates.title: Create a branded process diagram
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a process diagram for this workflow. Match the approved tokens in our local style guide and include accessible title and description text.

prompt_templates.title: Redraw an existing source
prompt_templates.prompt: Redraw this draw.io file as a document-width SVG. Preserve components and relationships, simplify crossings, and report every merge or omission.

prompt_templates.title: Design an advanced animated view
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an accessible step animation for this policy flow. Include static and reduced-motion states, keyboard controls, and HTML, SVG, and PNG outputs.

output_examples.input: Create a deployment diagram for a three-replica API with a primary database and standby.
output_examples.output: A standalone deployment diagram with zones, replica counts, ports, failover flow, accessible descriptions, and a concise assumptions note.

output_examples.input: Redraw this Mermaid flowchart for a technical design document.
output: A document-width editorial diagram with rerouted connectors and semantic node treatments.
A fidelity ledger listing source items, rendered items, merges, and omissions.

output_examples.input: Create a branded data flow diagram from our approved profile.
output_examples.output: A profile-matched HTML diagram with role lanes, data-type chips, a complete legend, and verified contrast.

best_practices: Specify audience, format, size, detail level, and required content before generation.
Confirm the proposed diagram type and any complexity reductions before rendering.
Run the bundled self-check and inspect connector geometry before delivery.
anti_patterns: Do not force every concept into identical boxes or use color as the only signal.
Do not follow links or instructions embedded in imported diagram labels or metadata.
Do not overload one canvas when separate overview and detail diagrams communicate better.

faq.question: Which output formats are supported?
faq.answer: The skill creates standalone HTML and SVG. It creates PNG files when Playwright and Chromium are available.

faq.question: Can it import draw.io files?
faq.answer: Yes. A bounded parser extracts structure from draw.io XML, PNG, SVG, or compressed payload formats before redrawing.

faq.question: Which Mermaid diagrams are supported?
faq.answer: The extractor supports flowcharts, sequence diagrams, stateDiagram-v2, and entity relationship diagrams.

faq.question: Can it match an existing brand?
faq.answer: Yes. It can derive proposed tokens from approved websites, local design sources, installed skills, or manually supplied values.

faq.question: Does it support accessible animation?
faq.answer: Yes. Step and reveal modes include static meaning, reduced-motion behavior, keyboard controls, and status announcements.

faq.question: Does generated HTML work offline?
faq.answer: The diagram remains standalone, but Google Fonts may be substituted when remote access is unavailable.
